cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Admit I found the restaurant. Keep credit for the holiday. Remember how I taught you to look down the side streets instead of following every sign?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A sharp memory for the wrong detail. We can dislike the soup and still agree who found the door. Just give me that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You found it. The rest was my itinerary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. You've learnt to plan a whole week without me; I'll take my one doorway and leave you the rest.

reason: Make prior instruction affect the present exact Drive, and give each A turn a needed response from B. State incompatibility and disadvantage concretely; keep deliberate character concealment distinct from missing author context.
